items.exampleEn: He missed the train and consequently arrived late.
items.exampleZh: 他錯過了火車，因此晚到了。

items.exampleEn: My goodness, look at all this snow!
We watched a movie and had dinner afterwards.
items.exampleZh: 我們看了一部電影，之後去吃晚餐。

items.exampleEn: I found my phone underneath the sofa.
items.exampleZh: 我在沙發底下找到了手機。

items.exampleEn: Let's go someplace quiet to talk.
items.exampleZh: 我們去個安靜的地方聊聊吧。

items.exampleEn: Gee, I did not know you could cook so well!
items.exampleZh: 哇，我不知道你這麼會煮菜！

items.exampleEn: It is important to take care of oneself.
items.exampleZh: 照顧好自己是很重要的。
你喜歡哪個位子就坐哪個。

items.sentenceEn: My keys were underneath a pile of papers.
items.sentenceZh: 我的鑰匙在一疊紙下面。

items.audioEn: Peter forgot his umbrella and consequently got wet on the way home.
items.audioZh: Peter 忘了帶傘，結果在回家路上淋濕了。

items.sentenceEn: You can choose whichever color you like best.
items.sentenceZh: 你最喜歡哪個顏色，就選哪個。

items.sentenceEn: Let's find someplace warm to wait for the bus.
items.sentenceZh: 我們找個暖和的地方等公車吧。

items.stemEn: The cat is sleeping ____ the bed again.
items.stemZh: 那隻貓又在床底下睡覺了。

items.stemEn: She did not study for the test and ____ failed it.
items.stemZh: 她沒有準備考試，結果沒考過。

items.passageEn: Last Sunday, Amy could not find her passport. She looked underneath the bed and inside every bag. "My goodness, where is it?" she said. Her flight was the next day, and she needed someplace quiet to think. Then she remembered her old coat, and the passport was in its pocket. "Gee, I never thought it would be there!" she said. She had forgotten where she put it. Consequently, she spent three hours looking for it. Afterwards, she put it in a safe box so it would not get lost again.
items.passageZh: 上週日，Amy 找不到她的護照。她找了床底下，也翻遍了每個包包。她說：「天哪，到底在哪裡？」她的班機就在隔天，她需要找個安靜的地方好好想一想。後來她想起了那件舊外套，護照就在口袋裡。她說：「哇，我從沒想過它會在那裡！」她忘了自己把護照放在哪裡，結果找了三個小時。之後，她把護照放進保險箱，免得再弄丟。

questions.questionZh: Amy 的護照最後在哪裡找到？
找到護照之後，Amy 做了什麼？

items.promptZh: 你可以拿任何一本你想要的書。
referenceEn: You can take whichever book you want.
You can have whichever book you want.
rubricZh: whichever 後面可接名詞（book）或 one
you want 放在名詞後面修飾

items.instructionZh: 用 consequently 造一個句子，說明一件事造成的結果。
referenceEn: It rained all day. Consequently, the game was canceled.
I forgot to set my alarm and consequently woke up late.
rubricZh: 前面是原因，後面是結果
可放在句首加逗號，或放在 and 後面

She had forgotten where she put it. Consequently, she spent three hours looking for it. Afterwards, she put it in a safe box so it would not get lost again."（原 "Last Sunday, Amy could not find her passport. She looked underneath the bed and inside every bag.
